note: Normative inventory of Design System components. Prefer extending an entry over inventing a parallel control.

components.name: AppIcon
components.notes: Brand logos via Simple Icons (CC0) when the app name matches the catalog (SAP, Salesforce, AWS, Google); otherwise first-letter tile. Product AppBadge appearance="logo" consumes this. Used first on SoD Resolution V3.

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: soft = rounded-square for lists; circle = profile cards with grey outline + 2px surface gap. See ADR-0009.

components.name: Card
components.notes: Header uses 15px regular title + 15px filled icon. padding=none keeps a horizontal content gutter so flush-list dividers stay inset. See ADR-0009.

components.name: InfoRow
components.notes: Table-like label/value rows via InfoRowGroup — values share one left edge. Do not right-align or hug the label.

components.name: Switch
components.notes: Contained thumb inside pill track; brand fill when on. Do not use raw MUI Switch in product code.
